offices.title: Commissioner of Campbell Fund
offices.org_name: Town of Westminster Commissioners of Campbell Fund

sources.note: Town of Westminster, Selectboard minutes, April 14, 2026 (draft/unapproved, disclosed; each motion carried 3-0 for a one-year term ending March 2027): Pete Harrison was appointed 'Commissioner of the Public Fund and Campbell fund'. He had resigned as a fund trustee effective February 28, 2026, then was appointed commissioner. One commissioner seat stays open.

offices.title: Trustee of Campbell Fund
offices.org_name: Town of Westminster Trustees of Campbell Fund

sources.note: Town of Westminster, Selectboard minutes, April 14, 2026 (draft/unapproved, disclosed; each motion carried 3-0 for a one-year term ending March 2027): Barbara Taylor was appointed 'Trustee of the Campbell and Public Fund', filling her own seat, which had drawn only write-ins at the March 3, 2026 election. The single bundled motion names her trustee of BOTH funds, so she is recorded on both trustee posts (modeling call disclosed on issue #163).
